# 易翼說

**ID:** KR1a0149
**Custom ID:** ZB1a0146b
**Source:** 四庫全書 文淵閣版, V49.4, p471
**Extent:** 8 卷

## Authors / Editors
- 晏斯盛 (清朝) 撰

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The Wing-commentary member of [晏斯盛](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%8F%E6%96%AF%E7%9B%9B) Yàn Sīshèng's three-part *Yì*-corpus, in eight juàn — the third volume after [KR1a0147](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0147) (the *Xué Yì chū jīn* methodological framework) and [KR1a0148](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0148) (the *Yì yì zōng* canonical commentary). The work fully glosses all Ten Wings of the *Zhōuyì*, but in an unusual order: *Xìcí* — *Shuōguà* — *Xùguà* — *Záguà* — *Tuàn* — *Wényán* — *Xiàng*. This is neither the canonical *gǔ Yì* sequence (*Tuàn shàng* — *Tuàn xià* — *Xiàng shàng* — *Xiàng xià* — *Xìcí shàng* — *Xìcí xià* — *Wényán* — *Shuōguà* — *Xùguà* — *Záguà*) nor the *jīn Yì* arrangement; the *Sìkù* editors note "non-ancient, non-modern; one does not know what edition is the basis."

The *Sìkù* editors' joint assessment of all three works (in the *Xué Yì chū jīn* tíyào, [KR1a0147](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0147)) applies: methodologically distinctive but well-grounded in canonical text; substantively avoiding both the technical-numerology and the metaphysical-talk extremes; "still substantive-and-near-reason among recent *Yì*-houses."

**Abstract**

Composition is bracketed by Yàn's mid-Qiánlóng career; see [KR1a0147](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0147) for biographical details. The *Yì yì shuō* is the Wing-commentary final member of Yàn's three-part *Yì*-corpus.

The work's distinctive feature is the unusual sequence of Wing-glossing. Beginning with the *Xìcí* (rather than the *Tuàn*) suggests Yàn took the *Xìcí*'s methodological reflections as the conceptual foundation for understanding the rest; ending with the *Xiàng* makes the symbol-and-image readings the application of the conceptual foundation. This is a non-standard but coherent methodological architecture.
